findings.summary: Carrying over the previous log's 'Met this goal' choice means a new event can be saved as qualifying without the owner marking it, which contradicts the ContactEvent invariant and removes the former unchecked default.
findings.evidence: screen.logContact: "channel, depth and the Met this goal choice carry over" (removed: "Met this goal defaults unchecked") vs entity.ContactEvent invariant "Qualifies only when the owner explicitly marks that it met this goal"

findings.summary: The prefill behaviour has no defined default for a person with no previous log, even though the spec explicitly covers the zero-logs case elsewhere.
findings.evidence: "The form opens prefilled from this person's previous log"; "Prefilled with the channel of this person's previous log"; C.webapp.schedule.correct covers "zero logs"

findings.summary: The form-prefill description was attached to step c4, which runs on screen.person; the ContactEventForm actually opens at step c5 on screen.logContact.
findings.evidence: J.contact/c4 action "Log what happened? The form opens prefilled from the previous log" with stepScreen screen.person; c5 stepScreen screen.logContact
